values.note: Family rate (2 adults, 2 kids, 1 RV): electric $35 / electric-and-water $40 from April 12 to May 20 and September 11 to November 30; $45 / $50 from May 20 to September 10. Rustic sites $25 / $35 are left out of the range. Campspot quoted the same figures for October-November 2026 and June 2027 (read 2026-10-13), plus the park's $5 campground fee once per stay. Group rates (3+ adults or 2+ RVs) are per RV plus per person and booked through the office.

values.note: Modern restrooms with hot showers, playground, fishing ponds, and an overnight canoe landing on the Pine River. Small camp store with camping and river supplies, firewood and ice (outside firewood not allowed).

facilities.source: https://coolwaterscamp.com/camping/ ('We offer modern restrooms, HOT SHOWERS, a playground, camping cabins, fishing ponds, and an overnight canoe landing along the Pine River') + https://coolwaterscamp.com/camp-store/ ('a small camp store that carries camping supplies, river accesories ... Firewood & ice available') + https://coolwaterscamp.com/rules/ ('NO OUTSIDE FIREWOOD ALLOWED IN PARK'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked online on the operator's own Campspot page ('BOOK NOW' on coolwaterscamp.com), whose site types take '1 RV' with no van/motorhome split. Group sites through the office. Stays of a month or longer need a signed agreement. Late check-in allowed by arrangement.

booking.source: https://coolwaterscamp.com/ (BOOK NOW -> https://www.campspot.com/book/coolwatercamp, 'Coolwater's On The Pine River - Wellston, MI', phone (231) 862-3481, read in a headless browser) + https://coolwaterscamp.com/rules/ ('If you are staying in our park for a month or longer, we require an agreement to be signed'; 'Late check-ins are allowed at any time, please just contact the park for instructions'), read 2026-10-25

note: Campground inside the Manistee National Forest near Wellston, 2 mi south of M-55 and 2 mi east of M-37, on the Pine River - a Blue Ribbon trout stream and one of Michigan's fastest canoe rivers - with its own canoe landing. Cabins and trailer/pop-up rentals; ORVs may ride to and from sites. Not rated on RV Life; Campspot reviewers give it 4.8 (32 reviews). --Claude
summary: Operator's site + its Campspot page: rates $35-50 confirmed against the operator's rate card (and the dated Campspot read of 2026-10-13), 30-amp electric (new) and water (confirmed), hot showers/flush toilets/camp store (new), reservable on the operator's Campspot page (url new). Presence passes (working site with phone 231-862-3481, which matches, plus a booking engine); price gate passes (base $35-45, under $50). Long-stay: nightly in character (month-plus stays by agreement only). No closure notice. Website and name flags. Note trimmed of the per-family pricing line (now in fees.note) and the site-type list.
